title: Mashad me aaj shahe khurasaa hue shaheed
body:
MASHHAD MEIN AAJ SHAH-E-KHURASAA HUWE SHAHEED
ZEHRE DAGHA SE DEEN KE SULTAA’N HUWE SHAHEED
Angoor mein jo zehre dagha tha mila huwa
Khate hi haye sarwar-e-zeeshan huwe Shaheed
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar peeto khaak udao ghareeb-ul-dayaar par
Matam karo ke Saheb-e-Eimaa huwe Shaheed
Mehshar bapa hai Masooma-e-Qum ke bain se
Dil hai behen ka uske ye armaa’n huwe Shaheed
<<DIVIDER>>
Matam hai haye Ahle-e-Khurasaa’n mein momino
Ghurbat mein hum gharebo ke mehmaa’n huwe Shaheed
Mitti pe lot-te hai kaleje ko thaam ke
Kis bekasi se shaah-e-khurasa huwe Shaheed
<<DIVIDER>>
Rokar Taqi ye kehte hai baba ki laash par
Zulm-o-sitam se sab ke nigehbaa’n huwe Shaheed
Kis kamsini mein daagh yateemi ka de gaye
Hum sab ko karke besaro samaa’h huwe Shaheed
<<DIVIDER>>
Maiyat pa nauha karte hain sab bekas-o-ghareeb
Qasim jo aaj Faqr-e-sulemaa’n huwe Shaheed
